<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  // Wait for DOM to be ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
  
  function init() {
    // 3D Tilt Effect for Cards
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.card, .product-card, .collection-card, .media-card');
    
    cards.forEach(card => {
      card.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease';
      card.style.transformStyle = 'preserve-3d';
      
      card.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        this.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)';
      });
      
      card.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
        const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
        const centerX = rect.width / 2;
        const centerY = rect.height / 2;
        const rotateX = ((y - centerY) / centerY) * 15;
        const rotateY = ((centerX - x) / centerX) * 15;
        
        this.style.transform = `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg) scale(1.05) translateZ(20px)`;
        this.style.boxShadow = '0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
      });
      
      card.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        this.style.transform = 'perspective(1000px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0) scale(1) translateZ(0)';
        this.style.boxShadow = '';
      });
    });
    
    // Add product-card-3d class to product cards
    const productCards = document.querySelectorAll('.product-card, [class*="product"]');
    productCards.forEach(card => {
      if (!card.classList.contains('product-card-3d')) {
        card.classList.add('product-card-3d');
      }
    });
    
    // Scroll Reveal Animation
    const observerOptions = {
      threshold: 0.15,
      rootMargin: '0px 0px -100px 0px'
    };
    
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
          entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }
      });
    }, observerOptions);
    
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section, .section, [class*="section"]');
    sections.forEach(section => {
      section.style.opacity = '0';
      section.style.transform = 'translateY(40px)';
      section.style.transition = 'opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease';
      observer.observe(section);
    });
    
    // Add floating animation to emojis
    const emojis = document.querySelectorAll('p');
    emojis.forEach(p => {
      if (/[✨🌸💎👗👚👖💖💫⭐🛍️]/.test(p.textContent)) {
        p.style.display = 'inline-block';
        p.style.animation = 'float 4s ease-in-out infinite';
      }
    });
  }
})();
</script>

<style>
  .button-primary, .button-secondary {
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) !important;
    transform-style: preserve-3d !important;
  }
  
  .button-primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px) translateZ(20px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3) !important;
    animation: pulse-3d 2s infinite !important;
  }
  
  .button-secondary:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1) translateZ(10px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) !important;
  }
</style>
